dz: 葡萄牙勃艮第王室的男性一行随着费尔南多国王的去世而灭绝,只剩下他的女儿比阿特丽斯. 里瓦尔索赔者开始内战和混乱时期.
de: The male line of the Portuguese House of Burgundy becomes extinct with the death of King Fernando, leaving only his daughter Beatrice. Rival claimants begin a period of civil war and disorder.
